definitions.explanation: A geometric shape with three sides and three angles.
Something having the shape of a triangle.

notes:
{三角|さんかく} means triangle or triangular. Composed of ⟦{三|さん}→三：00749_san⟧ (three) + ⟦{角|かく}→角：noentry⟧ (angle/corner).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{三角形|さんかくけい}→三角形：05436_sankakukei⟧: triangle (geometric term)
- {三角|さんかく}⟦{定規|じょうぎ}→定規：04280_jougi⟧: set square/triangle ruler
- {三角|さんかく}⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧: love triangle
- {三角|さんかく}⟦{関数|かんすう}→関数：04796_kansuu⟧: trigonometric function

EVERYDAY USE:
- ⟦おにぎり→おにぎり：04956_onigiri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{三角|さんかく}: triangular rice ball shape
- {三角|さんかく}⟦{巾|きん}→巾：noentry⟧: triangular bandage (first aid)

MATH USAGE:
In geometry: ⟦{三角形|さんかくけい}→三角形：05436_sankakukei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{面積|めんせき}→面積：05330_menseki⟧ (area of a triangle). {三角|さんかく}⟦{関数|かんすう}→関数：04796_kansuu⟧ (trigonometric functions) appears in high school math.
